comments.author: qpmz234
comments.body_html:
Looks like the only thing broken by the 3.4.0 update is the locale handling, so I’ve whipped up a quick fix for myself and thought I’d share it with anyone still waiting for an official update.

Within CNN_CONTAINER\src\api\CNNApi.ts, replace lines 74-83 (the old locale block) with the following:

//add custom item names to all languages/locales const locales = Object.values(this.global) as Record<string, string>[]; for (const locale of locales) { locale[${item.Id} Name] = item.Name locale[${item.Id} ShortName] = item.ShortName locale[${item.Id} Description] = item.Description }I hope this helps somebody.

“_id”: “5c127c4486f7745625356c15”,

“_name”: “main”,

“_parent”: “item_container_gearbox”,

“_props”: {
